tasks.title: Live migration simulator
tasks.statement: Move a running machine with 16 GiB of memory to another server in three scenarios: a calm, an active and a very active guest. Tune the allowed downtime, vCPU throttling, compression and the moment of switching to post-copy, and watch how the pre-copy rounds reduce the remainder. The exercise is solved when the goals of all three scenarios are met.
tasks.hint: Migration converges when the guest's write rate is lower than the network throughput; otherwise you need throttling, compression or post-copy.
